rules.nondelay: admissible when the processing start is within half an hour of the earliest processing start over the compatible pairs (the rule of the paper)
rules.block: admissible when the block start (after the push past outages, before the setup) is within half an hour of the earliest block start over the compatible pairs (classical non-delay on block starts)
rules.active: admissible when the processing start is earlier than the earliest completion over the compatible pairs by more than half an hour (Giffler-Thompson)

orders.A: (s_R(o), [m != m_R(o)], completion, m, j), smallest first
orders.B: ([m != m_R(o)], s_R(o), completion, m, j), smallest first
orders.C: (c_R(o), [m != m_R(o)], completion, m, j), smallest first

random_stream: default_rng(SeedSequence([20261113, code, instance index, draw])), codes pub10x5 105, 10x25 10, 50x25n30 50, 80x25n30 80
diff: 100 (x_X - x_nondelay) / x_nondelay per case; negative means rule X gives the shorter schedule
bootstrap: stats_family.instance_boot, 20000 resamples, fresh default_rng(7); pooled, a drawn instance brings all its combinations
pairs: along the SPT rollout under each rule: admissible pairs before every decision, over all decisions of all cases of the row
rows: per combination; All: pooled over the selected combinations; Setup: pooled over S, LS, SW, LSW

refs.memetic_rule600: memetic algorithm, 600 s, seeded with the rule schedules (timed campaign, memetic_rule@600)

pub10x5.text: public benchmark, SD2 test set 10x5, 100 instances

10x25.text: factory benchmark, 10 modules, the 100 test instances
